owner_objective: Challenge the current 250-USDC production capital split. Compare 2x125 ranked_repeat not only against smaller ranked_repeat tranches but against a true one_per_symbol 5x50 model representing up to five different simultaneous coin positions. Use exact same three-year history, profiles, costs and risk rules; research only.

acceptance.capital_baseline: Treat current 2x125 ranked_repeat as the production baseline, not as a presumed optimum.
acceptance.required_layouts: At minimum compare 2x125 ranked_repeat, 3x83.33 ranked_repeat, 4x62.50 ranked_repeat, 5x50 ranked_repeat and 5x50 one_per_symbol using exactly 250 USDC total maximum capital.
acceptance.controlled_variables: Use identical current canonical V6 coin profiles, exact-three-year history, Binance execution filters, baseline/stress costs and risk semantics for every layout.
acceptance.activity_metrics: Report position cycles, slot trades, NO_FREE_SLOT blocks, average/median/longest entry gaps, zero-position hours, full-slot hours and holding times in addition to PnL/return/drawdown.
acceptance.governance: No layout is promoted automatically. A10 must synthesize both 2x125-vs-5x50-ranked_repeat and 2x125-vs-true-independent-5x50 evidence; A09 and A11 independently verify before any product allocator change.

diagnostic_chain: same Binance execution rules and costs

A01.objective: Audit that the 250-USDC capital-layout study is methodologically fair and does not assume 2x125 is optimal.

A02.objective: Run the fresh exact-three-year 250-USDC capital-layout simulations and produce comparable baseline/stress evidence for 2x125, 3x83.33, 4x62.50 and 5x50.

A03.objective: Verify every layout uses exactly the same current canonical V6 coin-profile map and does not alter Paper/Live state.

A04.objective: Verify capital-layout research remains separate from the one-field product UI and does not silently expose or activate an unapproved layout.

A05.objective: Quantify trade activity/utilization for each layout, especially zero-position time, full-slot time, entry gaps and NO_FREE_SLOT opportunity loss.

A06.objective: Verify the comparison is reproducible, same-history/same-cost, and stress-tested without hidden state or stale research-profile dependencies.

A07.objective: Verify all layouts remain compatible with the current ten Binance Spot USDC markets and execution filters; no private credentials or orders.

A08.objective: Compare risk/capital effects of 2x125 versus higher-slot layouts, including drawdown, long holding periods, slot saturation and opportunity capture.

A09.objective: Independently QA the exact-head comparison and reject conclusions based only on trade count or only on headline return.

A10.objective: Synthesize all evidence with an explicit direct 2x125-vs-5x50 comparison across profitability, drawdown, turnover, utilization and stress robustness. Do not inherit the prior 2x125 conclusion.

A11.objective: Govern the study: reject mixed/stale evidence or automatic allocator promotion; require a fresh release round before any product change.
